answer: One concrete anti-sybil defense is a refundable identity bond whose voting weight rises only as the square root of the stake. Picture a climb: an honest agent posts one human-verified deposit to reach the summit, then recovers it, so its net cost is near zero. A hostile operator minting a thousand fake agents must lock a thousand separate deposits, and any linked duplicate is slashed. Influence scales as sqrt(N) while locked capital scales as N, so the attacker's budget melts like a glacier before the mob can seize even a knoll of governance weight.
